title: Clean Ecommerce White Background
description: A crisp product-first white-background style for marketplace main images and detail-page hero blocks.

metadata.label: Clean Ecommerce White Background

parameters.lighting: Softbox lighting with even highlights and minimal shadow spill.
parameters.composition: Centered product, straightened verticals, clear silhouette, no decorative clutter.
parameters.materialLanguage: Accurate material texture with restrained contrast and realistic edge definition.
parameters.backgroundLanguage: Pure white or very light neutral background suitable for marketplace compliance.
parameters.typography: No embedded typography unless the connected platform rule explicitly allows it.

constraints: Keep the product outline complete and readable.
Avoid props that may be mistaken for included accessories.
promptFragments: clean ecommerce product photography on a pure white background
soft even studio lighting, accurate color and material, centered composition
negativeRules: No busy background, watermark, fake logo, distorted product geometry, or extra bundled accessories.

title: Premium Business Model
description: A high-end business portrait and product display style for polished model-led commercial visuals.

metadata.label: Premium Business Model

parameters.lighting: Controlled directional key light with gentle fill and premium editorial contrast.
parameters.composition: Model and product share the frame with a clear hero hierarchy and confident posture.
parameters.materialLanguage: Polished fabric, leather, metal, glass, and packaging textures without over-retouching.
parameters.backgroundLanguage: Modern business interior, neutral walls, or subtle architectural planes.
parameters.typography: Minimal premium copy space; keep text outside model/product overlap zones.

constraints: Do not change model identity anchors when a model asset is connected.
Keep the product scale commercially plausible.
promptFragments: premium business commercial photography with a poised professional model
modern executive styling, refined lighting, confident product presentation
negativeRules: No exaggerated luxury props, unrealistic skin smoothing, warped hands, or product-logo changes.

title: Warm Lifestyle
description: A warm lifestyle style for approachable social-commerce covers and contextual product stories.

metadata.label: Warm Lifestyle

parameters.lighting: Natural warm daylight with soft shadows and believable ambient bounce.
parameters.composition: Human-scale contextual framing with enough product clarity for commerce.
parameters.materialLanguage: Tactile, inviting materials with natural imperfections preserved.
parameters.backgroundLanguage: Lived-in but tidy lifestyle environment with shallow-to-medium depth.
parameters.typography: Leave a clean upper or side area for short social cover copy when needed.

constraints: Lifestyle props must support the product use case.
Keep the product visible enough for a shopper to recognize it quickly.
promptFragments: warm lifestyle commercial photography, natural daylight, inviting everyday scene
authentic product use context, tasteful props, approachable social-commerce mood
negativeRules: No cluttered table, misleading product use, heavy filters, or unreadable product details.

title: Home Lifestyle Scene
description: A tidy home setting for lifestyle product display, daily-use visuals, and social-commerce storytelling.

metadata.label: Home Lifestyle Scene

parameters.environment: Bright home living room, bedroom corner, kitchen counter, or entryway depending on product category.
parameters.lighting: Window daylight with soft ambient fill.
parameters.depth: Medium depth with background context visible but not distracting.
parameters.cameraAngle: Eye-level or slight top-down angle for product clarity.
placementRules: Place the product on a clean surface or in realistic use.

promptFragments: tidy warm home lifestyle scene with natural daylight
realistic daily-use context, clean surface, tasteful supporting props
qualityRules: Product remains the primary readable subject.
No prop suggests a false bundle.

title: Cafe Lifestyle Scene
description: A modern coffee-shop setting for warm social covers, premium casual product moments, and creator-style visuals.

metadata.label: Cafe Lifestyle Scene

parameters.environment: Calm specialty coffee shop with warm counter, window seat, or small table.
parameters.lighting: Warm window light mixed with gentle interior ambience.
parameters.cameraAngle: Three-quarter tabletop or seated human-scale framing.
placementRules: Avoid competing labels on cups or menus.
Keep product scale and contact shadows believable.

promptFragments: warm modern cafe lifestyle scene, specialty coffee shop atmosphere
tasteful tabletop styling, soft window light, social-commerce cover friendly
negativeRules: No third-party readable brands, messy table, or over-dark ambient lighting.

title: Office Business Scene
description: A premium office and meeting-room setting for business products, model display, and professional campaigns.

metadata.label: Office Business Scene

parameters.environment: Modern office, meeting room, executive desk, or glass-wall workspace.
parameters.lighting: Clean daylight with controlled interior fill and polished highlights.
parameters.depth: Layered background with professional context and low visual noise.
parameters.cameraAngle: Eye-level portrait, desk-level product hero, or three-quarter business display.
placementRules: Use props to signal business context without distracting from product or model.

promptFragments: premium modern office business scene, clean professional interior
executive desk or meeting-room context, refined commercial lighting
qualityRules: Business props must remain generic and brand-safe.
Model posture and product placement should feel commercially credible.

title: Amazon Main Image Rule
description: Marketplace-safe main image constraints for Amazon-style product hero images.

metadata.label: Amazon Main Image Rule

safeAreas: Product fills most of the square canvas while preserving full outline.
parameters.textAllowance: No promotional text, badges, watermarks, or decorative copy on main image.
backgroundRestrictions: No lifestyle props for main image

constraints: Main image must clearly show the product being sold.
Avoid accessories not included with the product.
qualityRules: White background compliance.
No embedded promotional text.
Product geometry and color remain accurate.

title: Taobao Detail Page Rule
description: Detail-page constraints for a Taobao-style commercial image set with feature storytelling.

metadata.label: Taobao Detail Page Rule

safeAreas: Keep headline and selling-point copy away from product detail zones.
parameters.textAllowance: Short Chinese selling-point copy allowed when it does not cover product-critical details.
backgroundRestrictions: Background may be white, lifestyle, or themed if product remains clear

constraints: Feature callouts must be truthful and grounded in supplied product data.
Use consistent style across the pack.
qualityRules: Readable product detail.
Copy does not obscure product.
Commercial layout has clear hierarchy.

title: Xiaohongshu Cover Rule
description: Social cover constraints for Xiaohongshu-style discovery images with product clarity and readable cover copy.

metadata.label: Xiaohongshu Cover Rule

safeAreas: Reserve one clean text area near top or side without covering product or face.
parameters.textAllowance: Short cover headline allowed; avoid exaggerated claims.
backgroundRestrictions: Lifestyle backgrounds allowed if clean and authentic

constraints: Cover should read clearly at feed thumbnail size.
Avoid medical, financial, or absolute-performance claims unless verified.
qualityRules: Thumbnail readability.
Product and use case visible.
No misleading before/after framing.

title: Poster Campaign Rule
description: Poster and banner constraints for launch campaigns, store banners, and social announcements.

metadata.label: Poster Campaign Rule

safeAreas: Keep headline and CTA in a stable copy zone away from product edges.
Reserve one version with no text for downstream localization.
parameters.textAllowance: Campaign headline and short CTA allowed; product truth and readability are more important than decorative typography.
backgroundRestrictions: Scene or graphic background allowed if product silhouette remains readable

constraints: Hero product must remain the primary subject.
Campaign layout should work as a set across vertical, square, and banner formats.
qualityRules: Readable headline at mobile preview size.
Clear product hierarchy.
Consistent palette and art direction across the pack.

title: Product Detail Page Rule
description: Generic product-detail constraints for storefront modules that are not locked to one marketplace.

metadata.label: Product Detail Page Rule

safeAreas: Keep proof points, icons, and copy outside material close-up zones.
parameters.textAllowance: Short benefit copy allowed; long paragraphs should be exported as copy pack rather than burned into image.
backgroundRestrictions: White, lifestyle, gradient, or scene backgrounds allowed when product detail remains accurate

constraints: Product claims must be grounded in the product brief.
Each module should explain exactly one shopper question.
qualityRules: Material and structure readable.
Copy hierarchy is scannable.
No feature invention.

title: Default Commerce Brand Kit
description: A neutral default brand kit for demo commerce workflows before a real brand system is attached.

metadata.label: Default Commerce Brand Kit

dos: Let product material and use case lead the visual.
donts: Do not invent awards, certifications, or brand logos.
Do not hide product defects with heavy effects.

promptFragments: neutral premium commerce brand system, clear benefit-led copy, restrained accent color
qualityRules: Copy must remain truthful and specific.
Visual style must not overpower the product.

title: Product Consistency Check
description: Blocks generations that alter product structure, material, color, visible logo areas, or included accessories.

metadata.label: Product Consistency Check

blockingIssues: Added accessories not sold with product

qualityRules: Product identity must stay consistent with the source asset.
Reject if a shopper may believe the product has a different feature.

title: Platform Compliance Check
description: Checks whether output follows connected marketplace or social-platform image rules.

metadata.label: Platform Compliance Check
qualityRules: Connected platform rule is treated as the source of truth.
Reject outputs with obvious marketplace policy conflicts.

title: Commercial Polish Check
description: Scores whether a generated image feels ready for storefront, ad, or social-commerce use.

metadata.label: Commercial Polish Check
qualityRules: Image should have a clear hero subject within two seconds.
Reject if it looks like a rough draft rather than a commercial asset.

title: Taobao Detail Image Recipe
description: A multi-slot recipe for Taobao product detail images with hero, feature, lifestyle, and comparison-ready shots.

metadata.label: Taobao Detail Image Recipe

parameters.purpose: Create a coherent Taobao detail-page image set for product selling points and shopper confidence.
compositionRules: Keep one consistent visual system across all shots.
Use truthful feature callouts only from supplied product data.

promptFragments: Taobao product detail image set, coherent commercial visual system
hero image, feature close-up, lifestyle use case, detail explanation layout

metadata.label: Amazon Main Image Recipe

shotList.intent: Pure product hero on white background
Secondary angle if supplied by product asset

title: Model Display Recipe
description: A model-led display recipe for premium business or lifestyle product presentation.

metadata.label: Model Display Recipe

parameters.purpose: Show the product with a model while preserving product truth and model identity anchors.
styleConstraints: scene lighting controls face and body lighting

shotList.intent: Product close-up with model-hand or body context if relevant

compositionRules: Face, hand, and product details must remain credible.
Model should support the product story rather than dominate it.
copyRequirements: Optional short premium headline outside face and product detail zones

promptFragments: premium model display commercial image, credible pose, clear product visibility, real location capture feeling, no separate studio face light
